messages:
mira: opened PR to fix two small but confusing things in the /generate API docs: header casing in curl, and the sample response code (200 vs 202). https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12456
jon: thanks. what's the exact mismatch on the response sample?
mira: the current docs show a 202 Accepted with a body that looks like an immediate generation result. backend actually returns 200 OK for sync generate. 202 is only for async batch endpoints. users saw 202 in examples and got confused.
jon: ah ok. so change the example status code to 200 and confirm the response body shape matches openapi (choices vs output)?
mira: yes. also curl used `X-Request-Id:` header in one example, but SDK samples use `x-request-id`. we should standardize to lower-case in examples and add a short note about proxies that are case-sensitive.
polly: add link to migration guide? we had a support ticket last month where a proxy rejected uppercase headers. might help to call that out.
mira: good idea. adding a one-liner under "Notes" in the endpoint page and a changelog bullet pointing to the migration tip.
docs-ci-bot: docs lint: examples validated against OpenAPI schema: fail 
- sample status code (202) does not match documented responses for /generate
- curl example header casing differs from SDK snapshot
docs-ci-bot: suggestion: update example to `200` and normalize header to `x-request-id`
jon: can you paste the corrected curl and a minimal response sample here so QA can eyeball?
mira: sure. corrected curl: 
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RDW_KEY"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -H "x-request-id: $(uuidgen)"
  -d '{"model":"redwood/fast-1","input":"Summarize the note"}'
```
corrected response (200): 
```json
{
  "id": "gen_01F3...",
  "model": "redwood/fast-1",
  "outputs": [
    {"text": "TL;DR: ...", "token_count": 24}
  ],
  "usage": {"input_tokens": 12, "output_tokens": 24}
}
```
sre-oncall: looks fine from an SRE perspective. note for release: changing examples is safe but if docs are pinned in any customer-run playbooks they might be outdated. include a changelog entry.
jon: please add an automated snapshot test that asserts example status code and header casing for curl snippets to prevent regressions. small PR afterwards is fine.
mira: will add test follow-up + changelog bullet. rebasing now and will push green. pinging reviewers once CI passes ✅
docs-ci-bot: re-run: all checks passed ✅
polly: thanks! can we also update the SDK examples page to mention "examples use lowercase header names for portability"? small docs tweak but helpful for new users.
mira: will add that one-liner too. merging after green.
jon: great. leave a note in the release checklist to not revert these harmless docs edits unless there are test regressions.
mira: noted, thanks everyone :shipit:
